description:
Use this when the user asks whether a card's price is going up or down, how it
    moved over a period, or what it was worth on a past date. Returns the market price
    per printing in USD for the last `days` days (7 to 1000; history starts February
    2024, later for newer cards): daily for the most recent 90 days, and one price per
    calendar month (the month's last recorded day) for anything older; daily prices
    older than 90 days are on the card's TickerMint page for members and in the
    TickerMint API on a plan. Past prices only, no forecasts.
name: price_history
title: Price history
